audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot tabernacle instruction text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for freewill offering, sanctuary, ark, cover/mercy-seat, table, lampstand, and pattern shown on mountain.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel, that they take for me a contribution/offering; from every person whose heart moves willingly, you shall take my contribution.

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.

modern.text: “Tell the Israelites to bring Me an offering. You are to receive My offering from every man whose heart compels him.

original.text: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיִקְחוּ לִ֖י תְּרוּמָ֑ה מֵאֵ֤ת כָּל אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִדְּבֶ֣נּוּ לִבּ֔וֹ תִּקְח֖וּ אֶת תְּרוּמָתִֽי

verses.restored: This is the contribution you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,

familiar.text: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,

modern.text: This is the offering you are to accept from them: gold, silver, and bronze;

original.text: וְזֹאת֙ הַתְּרוּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּקְח֖וּ מֵאִתָּ֑ם זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת

verses.restored: blue, purple, scarlet yarn, fine linen, goats' hair,

familiar.text: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,

modern.text: blue, purple, and scarlet yarn; fine linen and goat hair;

original.text: וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ וְעִזִּֽים

verses.restored: reddened ram skins, durable hides, acacia wood,

familiar.text: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,

modern.text: ram skins dyed red and fine leather; acacia wood;

original.text: וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים וַעֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּֽים

verses.restored: oil for light, spices for anointing oil and fragrant incense,

familiar.text: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,

modern.text: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;

original.text: שֶׁ֖מֶן לַמָּאֹ֑ר בְּשָׂמִים֙ לְשֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְלִקְטֹ֖רֶת הַסַּמִּֽים

verses.restored: onyx stones and stones for setting, for ephod and breastpiece.

familiar.text: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.

modern.text: and onyx stones and gemstones to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

original.text: אַבְנֵי שֹׁ֕הַם וְאַבְנֵ֖י מִלֻּאִ֑ים לָאֵפֹ֖ד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן

verses.restored: They shall make for me a sanctuary, and I will dwell in their midst.

familiar.text: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.

modern.text: And they are to make a sanctuary for Me, so that I may dwell among them.

original.text: וְעָ֥שׂוּ לִ֖י מִקְדָּ֑שׁ וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֖י בְּתוֹכָֽם

verses.restored: According to all that I show you, pattern of dwelling-place and pattern of all its vessels, so you shall make it.

familiar.text: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.

modern.text: You must make the tabernacle and design all its furnishings according to the pattern I show you. The Ark of the Covenant (Exodus 37:1–5)

original.text: כְּכֹ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מַרְאֶ֣ה אוֹתְךָ֔ אֵ֚ת תַּבְנִ֣ית הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת תַּבְנִ֣ית כָּל כֵּלָ֑יו וְכֵ֖ן תַּעֲשֽׂוּ

verses.restored: They shall make an ark of acacia wood: two and a half cubits its length, one and a half cubits its width, and one and a half cubits its height.

familiar.text: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

modern.text: And they are to construct an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

original.text: וְעָשׂ֥וּ אֲר֖וֹן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֨יִם וָחֵ֜צִי אָרְכּ֗וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה וָחֵ֨צִי֙ רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: You shall overlay it with pure gold, inside and outside you shall overlay it, and make for it a gold molding all around.

familiar.text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.

modern.text: Overlay it with pure gold both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.

original.text: וְצִפִּיתָ֤ אֹתוֹ֙ זָהָ֣ב טָה֔וֹר מִבַּ֥יִת וּמִח֖וּץ תְּצַפֶּ֑נּוּ וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ עָלָ֛יו זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: You shall cast four gold rings for it and set them on its four feet, two rings on one side and two rings on other side.

familiar.text: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.

modern.text: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.

original.text: וְיָצַ֣קְתָּ לּ֗וֹ אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ה עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פַּעֲמֹתָ֑יו וּשְׁתֵּ֣י טַבָּעֹ֗ת עַל צַלְעוֹ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּי֙ טַבָּעֹ֔ת עַל צַלְע֖וֹ הַשֵּׁנִֽית

verses.restored: You shall make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

modern.text: And make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בַדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב

verses.restored: You shall bring poles into rings on sides of ark, to carry ark with them.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.

modern.text: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, in order to carry it.

original.text: וְהֵֽבֵאתָ֤ אֶת הַבַּדִּים֙ בַּטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֖ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הָאָרֹ֑ן לָשֵׂ֥את אֶת הָאָרֹ֖ן בָּהֶֽם

verses.restored: The poles shall remain in rings of ark; they shall not be removed from it.

familiar.text: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.

modern.text: The poles are to remain in the rings of the ark; they must not be removed.

original.text: בְּטַבְּעֹת֙ הָאָרֹ֔ן יִהְי֖וּ הַבַּדִּ֑ים לֹ֥א יָסֻ֖רוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ

verses.restored: You shall put into ark the testimony that I shall give you.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.

modern.text: And place inside the ark the Testimony, which I will give you. The Mercy Seat (Exodus 37:6–9)

original.text: וְנָתַתָּ֖ אֶל הָאָרֹ֑ן אֵ֚ת הָעֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶתֵּ֖ן אֵלֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: You shall make a cover/atonement-cover of pure gold: two and a half cubits its length and one and a half cubits its width.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

modern.text: And you are to construct a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ כַפֹּ֖רֶת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר אַמָּתַ֤יִם וָחֵ֨צִי֙ אָרְכָּ֔הּ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי רָחְבָּֽהּ

verses.restored: You shall make two cherubim of gold; of hammered work you shall make them from two ends of cover.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.

modern.text: Make two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat,

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ שְׁנַ֥יִם כְּרֻבִ֖ים זָהָ֑ב מִקְשָׁה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם מִשְּׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת

verses.restored: Make one cherub from this end and one cherub from that end; from the cover you shall make the cherubim upon its two ends.

familiar.text: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

modern.text: one cherub on one end and one on the other, all made from one piece of gold.

original.text: וַ֠עֲשֵׂה כְּר֨וּב אֶחָ֤ד מִקָּצָה֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וּכְרוּב אֶחָ֥ד מִקָּצָ֖ה מִזֶּ֑ה מִן הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֶת הַכְּרֻבִ֖ים עַל שְׁנֵ֥י קְצוֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: The cherubim shall be spreading wings upward, sheltering the cover with their wings, faces each toward the other; toward the cover shall faces of cherubim be.

familiar.text: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.

modern.text: And the cherubim are to have wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the mercy seat.

original.text: וְהָי֣וּ הַכְּרֻבִים֩ פֹּרְשֵׂ֨י כְנָפַ֜יִם לְמַ֗עְלָה סֹכְכִ֤ים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ עַל הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת וּפְנֵיהֶ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶל אָחִ֑יו אֶל הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת יִהְי֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הַכְּרֻבִֽים

verses.restored: You shall put the cover upon ark from above, and into ark you shall put testimony that I give you.

familiar.text: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.

modern.text: Set the mercy seat atop the ark, and put the Testimony that I will give you into the ark.

original.text: וְנָתַתָּ֧ אֶת הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל הָאָרֹ֖ן מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְאֶל הָ֣אָרֹ֔ן תִּתֵּן֙ אֶת הָ֣עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶתֵּ֖ן אֵלֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: There I will meet with you, and I will speak with you from above the cover, from between two cherubim that are upon ark of testimony, all that I command you for children of Israel.

familiar.text: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

modern.text: And I will meet with you there above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the Testimony; I will speak with you about all that I command you regarding the Israelites. The Table of Showbread (Exodus 37:10–16; Leviticus 24:5–9)

original.text: וְנוֹעַדְתִּ֣י לְךָ֮ שָׁם֒ וְדִבַּרְתִּ֨י אִתְּךָ֜ מֵעַ֣ל הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת מִבֵּין֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֑ת אֵ֣ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֲצַוֶּ֛ה אוֹתְךָ֖ אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: You shall make table of acacia wood: two cubits its length, one cubit its width, and one and a half cubits its height.

familiar.text: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

modern.text: You are also to make a table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ שֻׁלְחָ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֤יִם אָרְכּוֹ֙ וְאַמָּ֣ה רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: Overlay it with pure gold and make for it gold molding all around.

familiar.text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.

modern.text: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.

original.text: וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹת֖וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לּ֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: Make for it rim of handbreadth all around, and make gold molding for its rim all around.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.

modern.text: And make a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ לּ֥וֹ מִסְגֶּ֛רֶת טֹ֖פַח סָבִ֑יב וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ זֵר זָהָ֛ב לְמִסְגַּרְתּ֖וֹ סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: Make for it four gold rings and put rings on four corners that are on its four feet.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.

modern.text: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners at its four legs.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔וֹ אַרְבַּ֖ע טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וְנָתַתָּ֙ אֶת הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע הַפֵּאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַרְבַּ֥ע רַגְלָֽיו

verses.restored: Close to rim shall rings be, as housings for poles to carry table.

familiar.text: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.

modern.text: The rings are to be close to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.

original.text: לְעֻמַּת֙ הַמִּסְגֶּ֔רֶת תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן

verses.restored: Make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, and table shall be carried with them.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.

modern.text: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, so that the table may be carried with them.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֶת הַבַּדִּים֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְנִשָּׂא בָ֖ם אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן

verses.restored: Make its dishes, pans, jars, and bowls with which to pour libations; of pure gold you shall make them.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.

modern.text: You are also to make the plates and dishes, as well as the pitchers and bowls for pouring drink offerings. Make them out of pure gold.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ קְּעָרֹתָ֜יו וְכַפֹּתָ֗יו וּקְשׂוֹתָיו֙ וּמְנַקִּיֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻסַּ֖ךְ בָּהֵ֑ן זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם

verses.restored: You shall set bread of presence/faces on table before my face continually.

familiar.text: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.

modern.text: And place the Bread of the Presence on the table before Me at all times. The Lampstand (Exodus 37:17–24; Numbers 8:1–4)

original.text: וְנָתַתָּ֧ עַֽל הַשֻּׁלְחָ֛ן לֶ֥חֶם פָּנִ֖ים לְפָנַ֥י תָּמִֽיד

verses.restored: You shall make lampstand of pure gold; of hammered work lampstand shall be made, its base, stem, cups, bulbs, and blossoms from it.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.

modern.text: Then you are to make a lampstand of pure, hammered gold. It shall be made of one piece, including its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מְנֹרַ֖ת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר מִקְשָׁ֞ה תֵּעָשֶׂ֤ה הַמְּנוֹרָה֙ יְרֵכָ֣הּ וְקָנָ֔הּ גְּבִיעֶ֛יהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶ֥יהָ וּפְרָחֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּ֥נָּה יִהְיֽוּ

verses.restored: Six branches shall go out from its sides, three branches of lampstand from one side and three from other side.

familiar.text: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:

modern.text: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.

original.text: וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה קָנִ֔ים יֹצְאִ֖ים מִצִּדֶּ֑יהָ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֗ה מִצִּדָּהּ֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֔ה מִצִּדָּ֖הּ הַשֵּׁנִֽי

verses.restored: Three almond-blossom cups on one branch, bulb and blossom, and three almond-blossom cups on another branch, bulb and blossom; so for six branches going from lampstand.

familiar.text: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.

modern.text: There are to be three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch, each with buds and petals, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches that extend from the lampstand.

original.text: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְ֠בִעִים מְֽשֻׁקָּדִ֞ים בַּקָּנֶ֣ה הָאֶחָד֮ כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפֶרַח֒ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְבִעִ֗ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֛ים בַּקָּנֶ֥ה הָאֶחָ֖ד כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפָ֑רַח כֵּ֚ן לְשֵׁ֣שֶׁת הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן הַמְּנֹרָֽה

verses.restored: On lampstand itself four almond-blossom cups, its bulbs and blossoms.

familiar.text: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.

modern.text: And on the lampstand there shall be four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.

original.text: וּבַמְּנֹרָ֖ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה גְבִעִ֑ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֔ים כַּפְתֹּרֶ֖יהָ וּפְרָחֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: A bulb under two branches from it, a bulb under two branches from it, and a bulb under two branches from it, for six branches going from lampstand.

familiar.text: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.

modern.text: For the six branches that extend from the lampstand, a bud must be under the first pair of branches, a bud under the second pair, and a bud under the third pair.

original.text: וְכַפְתֹּ֡ר תַּחַת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י הַקָּנִ֜ים מִמֶּ֗נָּה וְכַפְתֹּר֙ תַּ֣חַת שְׁנֵ֤י הַקָּנִים֙ מִמֶּ֔נָּה וְכַפְתֹּ֕ר תַּחַת שְׁנֵ֥י הַקָּנִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑נָּה לְשֵׁ֨שֶׁת֙ הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן הַמְּנֹרָֽה

verses.restored: Their bulbs and branches shall be from it, all one hammered work of pure gold.

familiar.text: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.

modern.text: The buds and branches are to be all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.

original.text: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶ֥ם וּקְנֹתָ֖ם מִמֶּ֣נָּה יִהְי֑וּ כֻּלָּ֛הּ מִקְשָׁ֥ה אַחַ֖ת זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר

verses.restored: Make its seven lamps, and set up its lamps, so they give light before its face.

familiar.text: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.

modern.text: Make seven lamps and set them up on the lampstand so that they illuminate the area in front of it.

original.text: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת נֵרֹתֶ֖יהָ שִׁבְעָ֑ה וְהֶֽעֱלָה֙ אֶת נֵ֣רֹתֶ֔יהָ וְהֵאִ֖יר עַל עֵ֥בֶר פָּנֶֽיהָ

verses.restored: Its tongs and firepans shall be pure gold.

familiar.text: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.

modern.text: The wick trimmers and their trays must be of pure gold.

original.text: וּמַלְקָחֶ֥יהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶ֖יהָ זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר

verses.restored: From a talent of pure gold he shall make it, with all these vessels.

familiar.text: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.

modern.text: The lampstand and all these utensils shall be made from a talent of pure gold.

original.text: כִּכָּ֛ר זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑הּ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַכֵּלִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה

verses.restored: See and make by their pattern, which you are shown on the mountain.

familiar.text: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.

modern.text: See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.

original.text: וּרְאֵ֖ה וַעֲשֵׂ֑ה בְּתַ֨בְנִיתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה מָרְאֶ֖ה בָּהָֽר

translation_notes: Tabernacle begins with willing-hearted contribution, not coercive extraction.
Mishkan/sanctuary is for Divine dwelling in the people's midst after liberation.
Ark poles remain: holy presence is portable with the wilderness people.
Cover/kapporet is meeting-speaking place; later 'mercy seat' theology should be audited but not overlaid too quickly.
Lampstand botanical almond imagery evokes life/tree symbolism.
safety_note: Tabernacle material should not be framed as wealth extraction. The opening condition is willing heart, and the purpose is presence in the midst of a liberated people.
